title: Run Kev: surgeon-physician (9 cells, 8500 requests)
description:
**Self-contained run.** Give this issue ID to an agent on any Mac; it does the whole job.

**Job:** answer the capped subsample of the still-missing Kev cells for `surgeon-physician`: 9 cells, 8500 requests, roughly 13 minutes on a quiet Mac.

**Steps**
1. Read `docs/other-mac-runs.md` and follow it for setup (needs the amendment BD-c36da3, the runner change BD-3b4c76 and the guide BD-dd780c merged to main first).
2. Start the pinned Kev server, then run `python3 -m scripts.run_kev_study collect --manifest docs/kev-runs/surgeon-physician.json` with the registered identity flags from `docs/kev.md`. It resumes from partial files if interrupted.
3. Commit only the finished files under `answers/kev/surgeon-physician/` (never `.partial.jsonl`) to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push that branch. Do not merge to main. Do not run `bd replay`.
4. Comment on this issue with the request count and any errors, then close it.

**Rules:** one heavy job at a time on the machine; stop the Kev server when done; never touch `project/`.
